name: PAUL360
description: A German-language business platform built by Evelan and Profilium for managing Mandanten (clients) and their data. It was the main product I worked on at Evelan, where I built features across the full stack, from the database schema to the UI.
highlights: Turborepo monorepo with a Next.js app and Node.js services sharing TypeScript types
End-to-end type-safe API with tRPC: backend changes surface as type errors in the frontend
Prisma ORM over PostgreSQL for the data model and migrations
Real-time updates pushed to clients with Socket.IO
